notes.title: Cabbie! Demo 1.6 Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353752/9acd835be6c838a737d29501be4fc97a36eb9044.png[/img]

[h3]Hi there cabbies![/h3]

We have an update with fewer but significant changes:

[h3]Major update with 1.6:[/h3]
The scoring 'Tip' system has been updated to a new 'Happiness Meter' where you must keep the Meeplets happy by ensuring you keep completing fares, don't lose any, and stop the Sheeplets destroying the town; the higher the happiness level the higher the tip!!

[h3]Other updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The parking space in front of a building will start flashing from the time a Meeplet is coming out, so everyone will know where the next job is.
[*] Code optimizations which make the game run even smoother.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug where the game occasionally entered a screen with no options to continue after completing the tutorial;
[*] Fixed vehicles colliding in menus which made them fall off podiums.
[*] During the tutorial the correct input prompt will appear when at the charging station throughout all tutorial stages.
[/list]

We're hoping everyone is enjoying the lovely weather both outside and on Cabbie's home planet.

[h3]Happy driving everyone! ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

notes.title: Cabbie! Demo 1.5 Update
Cabbie! Demo 1.3 for Valentine's day
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353752/d9922fb15ea9532ba3055502fb6efbcfa6a814be.png[/img]

Happy Valentine's Day, Cabbies!

We're bringing you Cabbie Demo 1.3. 
We wanted to furtherly improve the gameplay fun so we've worked on different updates than the ones promised in our previous post. We will be bringing those much needed boss and post-match improvements in Demo 1.4. With this said, Demo 1.4 will now be the last major demo update before we'll go and build the rest of the game so you can play MORE! 

Lots of love,
Cabbie's Buddies

Updates:
[list]
[*] You now earn score for zapping Sheeplets;
[*] World 01 Level 03 now also has fireworks for awesome jumps;
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Score UI above your character no longer overlaps the job or interact UI that also appears in the same location;
[*] Post match celebrations screen shows the correct [enter] icon to continue for keyboard players, instead of the incorrect [backspace] icon;
[*] Exit prompt in the pause menu no longer disappears when you repeatedly pause;
[/list]
